provenance.what: Reduce input-order sensitivity of the SCORE, per tier. PAPER NUMBERS.
provenance.population: ALL 84 folds of the 28 units in data/results_sosym_r1/congen -- the whole shipped tree, so the population needs no justification. The drafts quote a 24-fold figure; which 8 cells it covered is recorded nowhere, so it cannot be reproduced and is not carried forward.
provenance.determinism: No global seed. Each fold's example shuffle uses that fold's committed shuffle_seeds; permutation p of fold i uses Random(1000*i + p). Re-running the command on this tree reproduces these numbers exactly.
provenance.method: B' is recovered from each scored fold as kb_constraints u redundant_constraints, gated against n_mss. Only B' is permuted; the memorized negative-example constraints stay first, as the shipped code assembles them.
provenance.spread_definition: per fold and tier, max over {P, R} of (max - min) across the 20 permutations. The ratio is description spread / semantic spread, as the tool itself reports it.
